evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and modifies src/test/fuzz/ to add framework support for target-specific custom mutators and a structure-aware PSBT mutator.
rationale: Significantly improves fuzzer coverage for deep PSBT parsing logic that is otherwise unreachable with raw byte mutations. As noted in the PR description, byte-level mutations rarely produce well-formed key-value maps with valid cryptographic structures, causing the deserialize target to reject nearly all inputs in early superficial checks.
